messages:
devon (Marketing): Heads-up: need a compact social + webinar slide kit for Apr 8 webinar. Focus: benchmarking visuals that show latency vs cost tradeoffs. Deliverables: 3 social sizes, 6-slide deck templates (editable), 1 hero diagram (svg + png), 3 benchmark cards (png + svg), 2 thumbnail options. Brand-safe. Deadline: Apr 2 EOD. @maria (Design) @lee (Brand) can you pick this up? brief in Figma: https://www.figma.com/file/xyz/Inference-Kit

maria (Design): On it. quick q — tone? more technical detail or exec-level?

devon (Marketing): Exec-level for the slides. Social can skew technical (benchmarks callouts). Use "Inference economics" headline. Avoid specific model names in hero graphic — use generic terms like "open models" or "modern open models".

lee (Brand): Brand constraints: follow new color tokens (primary #0A62FF, accent #00C48C). Use Redwood Sans, no drop shadows on diagrams. Logo spacing: min 16px clear space. Also require AA contrast check for any text on color.

maria (Design): Got it. Uploading roughs to Figma in 30m. Quick question: include per-token pricing axes labels or keep them relative bands?

sam (PM): Please include absolute numbers in small caption text for technical viewers, e.g. $0.0003/token. But primary viz can show relative bands and callouts to avoid overloading non-technical slides.

jen (Creative Ops): I'll set up the export naming and pipeline: example naming convention — webinar-hero-v1.svg, social-1200x675-v1.png, social-1080x1080-v1.png, card-benchmark-A-v1.png. Any copy/legal approvals needed?

lee (Brand): Legal review only required if we include third-party customer logos or their data. Product marketing copy is fine without legal sign-off for this kit.

figma-bot: Figma file updated — https://www.figma.com/file/xyz/Inference-Kit — 3 frames added by maria (Design).

maria (Design): Dropped 2 hero variants and 3 benchmark card drafts (data placeholders) in the Figma file. Marked components for export. Need final dataset from research to lock numbers.

devon (Marketing): Research to deliver final numbers by Mar 29. @sam can you confirm that timeline?

sam (PM): Confirmed. I'll push final CSV to /marketing/assets/data/inference-bench.csv by 2025-03-29 18:00 PST.

maria (Design): Perfect — will swap placeholders on 3/30 and prepare final exports.

jen (Creative Ops): :thumbsup: Plan: exports completed by 4/1, social scheduling pack + 4 caption variants (LI/X/Twitter/IG) by 4/2. Also preparing a screenshot+alt-text sheet for accessibility. Any A/B preferences?

devon (Marketing): Preference: Variant A (info-forward) for LinkedIn, Variant B (visual-first) for X. Thanks everyone — ping me here if blockers come up.
